text_block_list.text:
One day, at Special Week's request,
we came out to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan!
Over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's someone here today
I want you to meet, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Who's this person you want me to meet?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you see, the thing is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's my other mama!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually, when I was a child—

text_block_list.name: Young Spe
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... Mom...
Why did we come to the sea?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's because you said...
you wanted to see your other mom.

text_block_list.name: Young Spe
text_block_list.text: "But my other mom... She's already..."

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Whenever your mother and I had troubles,
we'd often talk things out here on this beach...

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's why even now, whenever I feel lost,
I come here and let them listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Young Spe
text_block_list.text: You want your other mama to listen to you...?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Even if I can't see them,
they definitely came for me...
I can just tell... somehow.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you've got something on your mind, just speak up.
I'm sure they'll listen to you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since then, whenever I have something
I want to tell my other Mom, I come to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little late for this,
but I realized I never introduced you to my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I suppose Hokkaido's sea would be ideal, but the ocean is all connected anyway.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure my other mom
will hear me out from here, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, here we go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mommaaa!!
This is my Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: They're kind! And smart! They're the absolute best Trainer who supports my dream--!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mommaaaaa!!
I'm so glad I came to Tracen Academyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I finally got to tell her.
I wonder if Ma is happy for me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! If you'd like,
could you say a few words too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure your other mama
wants to talk with you too!

There was surely only one thing
I needed to tell her other mother—
choice_data_list: I'll make your daughter the best in Japan!
I will make your daughter number one in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe.
Let's do our best and aim to be number one in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't there anything else? Anything about me
that I should pass along to my other Mom?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Like 'You're working really hard~',
or 'Your dancing is getting so much better~'?"
choice_data_list: Please keep an eye on me so I don't overeat.
Please watch over me so I don't get injured.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!?
I haven't eaten that much~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-True, when the food is delicious,
I might overeat a little, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... And here Mom told me that
my other mother was a light eater.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why do I always end up overeating...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? Could my overeating
be a rebound from my other mom!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mommaaa!! I'm gonna eat a whole bunch
for your sake toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna eat lots of delicious food,
and keep on giving it my all forever and eveerrr!!

Her loud voice echoes across the sea.
Her other mother will surely continue to watch
over Special Week from now on.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That makes me sound like some kind
of total klutz who's always getting hurt!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Why are you looking away?!
I'm not clumsy at all, you know!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, I might be a little clumsy
sometimes, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? Could my clumsiness
be inherited from my other mom!?
(SPLAAASH!!)

Just then, a sudden, massive wave
surged over Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No way! Mommy, I'm so sorrrryyyy!!

A loud voice offering an apology echoed across the sea.
Whether by coincidence or mere imagination...
it felt as though the waves had calmed down a little.
